name: ph-tax-overview
description: Philippine tax overview for 2026 covering the BIR, peso reporting, individual calendar years and corporate fiscal years, source and residence distinctions, graduated personal income tax, ordinary and qualifying smaller-company corporate rates, the standard VAT rate and annual return deadlines. Use to establish which Philippine tax rules apply before computing an individual's or company's liability. Includes a worldwide-versus-Philippine-source comparison and a VAT-inclusive price example. Distinguishes tax exemptions from filing duties and ordinary income tax from final withholding, special regimes and transaction-specific VAT treatment. Detailed corporate, withholding, formation and contribution work follows the corresponding job-specific Guide and the actual official instruction.
